model: Teammate selected Model 2: char TF-IDF 2-4 grams + LinearSVC C=1; 3-fold sigmoid teacher calibration

q2.subsets: Nested equal-class subsets, numpy default_rng(42), preserved Model 2 partition row order
q2.metric: Training/validation AUROC from calibrated probability; margin AUROC also checked

q3.teacher: 3-fold sigmoid calibration using training rows only
q3.student: Fresh unchanged TF-IDF + LinearSVC pipeline on 8000 true labels plus selected pseudo-labels
q3.metric: Compare raw SVM margin AUROC; no student calibration on pseudo-labels and no student probability submission
q3.exclusion: Unlabeled normalized exact duplicate of train/validation, or hashed word-trigram cosine >=0.9 to validation, excluded using texts only

common.validation: Canonical teammate 2000-row stratified holdout, same membership as original seed42 split
common.sensitivity: Secondary evaluation excludes existing training-near-duplicate validation IDs with hashed word-trigram cosine >=0.9; main holdout is unchanged
